overviews.Urdu: Season 4 opens with Mehmed preparing for Rome. A conspiracy along the Ottoman–Akkoyunlu border pulls attention east and places his sons near a developing crisis. For viewers following Sultan Muhammad Fateh with Urdu subtitles, this is the starting point of the season’s new frontier conflict.
overviews.English: Mehmed’s next ambition is Rome, but a frontier plot threatens to interrupt his preparations. The season premiere connects western expansion with a growing eastern rivalry. Episode 84 begins the new season’s continuous Turkish broadcast sequence; an English-subtitled listing may also call it Season 4 Episode 1.

developments: Rome becomes the next objective
Mehmed prepares for a western campaign, with Bellini involved in gathering information.
The frontier becomes a pressure point
A papal scheme targets the Ottoman–Akkoyunlu border, drawing Bayezid and Mustafa toward trouble at Karasu.
An eastern rival comes into view
Uzun Hasan’s position makes the border crisis a threat to Mehmed’s plans for Rome.
84.context: This is the season opener. Start here before the Karasu demands in Episode 85; earlier conquests provide the background to Mehmed’s new Roman ambition.
people: Mehmed’s sons, caught near the frontier scheme.
The Akkoyunlu ruler on the other side of the developing conflict.
84.question: What sets up Season 4 in Episode 84?
84.answer: The contrast between Mehmed’s plans for Rome and the plot at the eastern frontier. The linked synopses establish this conflict without documenting every scene or the final outcome.

watch_tip.Urdu: Select Urdu Subtitles beside the Great Nation player. Do not choose Urdu Dubbed when you want the original Turkish episode with translated captions.
watch_tip.English: Choose English Subtitles on the Episode 1 / Bolum 84 page. Confirm the full broadcast number before switching from a season-numbered search result.

reading_notes.urdu_summary: چوتھے سیزن کی پہلی قسط میں سلطان محمد روم کی مہم کی تیاری کرتے ہیں، لیکن مشرقی سرحد پر ایک سازش ان کے منصوبے کو خطرے میں ڈال دیتی ہے۔ شہزادہ بایزید اور مصطفیٰ قراسو کے معاملے میں شامل ہوتے ہیں، جبکہ اوزون حسن کی طاقت ایک نئے تصادم کا خدشہ پیدا کرتی ہے۔ یہ خلاصہ قسط کے ابتدائی حالات بیان کرتا ہے، مکمل انجام نہیں۔
reading_notes.english_notes: Rome is the proposed western campaign, while Karasu is the frontier pressure point. Keep those two locations separate when following the opening synopsis: the border crisis threatens the campaign rather than being the campaign itself. Bayezid and Mustafa are Mehmed’s sons; Uzun Hasan is the Akkoyunlu ruler. Episode 1 / original 84 establishes these relationships before the demand in Episode 2.
terms: The rival state connected with Uzun Hasan.

overviews.Urdu: Karasu’s bloodshed turns the border crisis into a demand Mehmed cannot easily accept. Uzun Hasan seeks redress for Behram’s death, while diplomacy competes with forces working against peace. The Urdu-subtitled Episode 85 continues directly from Season 4’s opening episode.
overviews.English: Episode 85 moves the conflict from a frontier plot into a diplomatic confrontation. Mehmed sends an envoy to Tabriz, but the demand for either Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa puts negotiations under severe pressure. Plans for Rome remain vulnerable to a second war.

developments: An envoy goes to Tabriz
Mehmed sends Gedik Ahmed to seek a diplomatic response to the Karasu crisis.
Savcu delivers a difficult demand
Uzun Hasan’s terms call for Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa following Behram’s death.
Peace has opponents
Zeno and Tahrani work against reconciliation, threatening the preparations for Rome.
85.context: Episode 84 introduces the Karasu scheme. Episode 85 follows its political consequences, with the Roman campaign dependent on avoiding an eastern war.
people: The prince named in the ultimatum.
85.question: What is the main demand in Episode 85?
85.answer: Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa. This demand drives the episode’s diplomatic stakes; the source summaries do not establish the complete ending of the negotiations.

watch_tip.Urdu: Look for both Episode 85 and Season 4 Episode 2. The Niazi Urdu link below uses a different listing ID from its English edition, so follow the language-specific link.
watch_tip.English: Match Season 4 Episode 2 with overall Episode 85, then choose English Subtitles. The Urdu listing is a separate edition and is not evidence that an English track plays.

reading_notes.urdu_summary: قراسو میں خونریزی کے بعد سیاسی بحران بڑھ جاتا ہے۔ اوزون حسن بہرام کی موت کا جواب چاہتے ہیں۔ سلطان محمد گیدک احمد کو تبریز بھیجتے ہیں، جبکہ سفیر قراسو کے قلعے یا شہزادہ مصطفیٰ کا مطالبہ پیش کرتا ہے۔ زینو اور تہرانی امن کی کوششوں میں رکاوٹ بنتے ہیں۔ شائع شدہ خلاصہ مذاکرات کا مکمل انجام نہیں بتاتا۔
reading_notes.english_notes: The demand is a choice between territory and a person: Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa. Gedik Ahmed travels as Mehmed’s envoy, so this mission is a diplomatic effort in the published synopsis. Zeno and Tahrani are working against reconciliation. Keep the ultimatum separate from any final agreement; the linked summary establishes the pressure but does not supply a complete ending recap.
terms: Envoy; a representative sent to negotiate.
The destination of the Ottoman envoy mission.
Karasu Fortress; the territory named in the demand.

overviews.Urdu: Two connected crises bring diplomacy closer to collapse: Saruca is badly wounded in Constantinople, and Ottoman envoys face detention in Tabriz. Sultan Muhammad Fateh Episode 86 with Urdu subtitles follows the danger created by the previous episode’s negotiations.
overviews.English: The conflict now threatens people on both sides of the diplomatic exchange. Savcu faces an accusation after the attack on Saruca, while Gedik Ahmed’s party is trapped in Tabriz. Episode 86 keeps the choice between peace and war unresolved in the published synopsis.

developments: Saruca is seriously wounded
An attack in Constantinople triggers an investigation and raises tensions between the states.
Savcu faces an accusation
Savcu is detained in connection with the attack. Detention does not establish that he is the culprit.
The envoys are trapped
Tahrani’s manoeuvre endangers Gedik Ahmed, Bali Bey and the raiders in Tabriz, where they face judgment.
86.context: The envoy mission begins in Episode 85. Episode 86 shows how an attack in the Ottoman capital and danger in Tabriz can undermine that mission at the same time.
people: The wounded official whose attack sparks the investigation.
Members of the threatened Ottoman party in Tabriz.
86.question: Does Episode 86’s synopsis prove who attacked Saruca?
86.answer: No. It identifies Savcu’s detention and the surrounding suspicion. It does not prove his guilt, confirm Saruca’s eventual recovery, or provide the complete resolution in Tabriz.

watch_tip.Urdu: Open Episode 3 / Bolum 86 and select Urdu Subtitles. Savcu’s detention is an accusation in the synopsis, so a recap should not label him the confirmed attacker.
watch_tip.English: Use the English listing for overall Episode 86. Tabriz and Tebriz are alternative spellings of the same location in these summaries; they do not identify different episodes.

reading_notes.urdu_summary: تیسری قسط میں دارالحکومت میں ایک حملے کے بعد سفارت کاری مزید مشکل ہو جاتی ہے۔ ساروجہ شدید زخمی ہیں اور ساوجو کو شک کی بنیاد پر حراست میں لیا جاتا ہے۔ دوسری طرف تبریز میں عثمانی وفد خطرے میں ہے۔ کسی شخص کی حراست اس کے مجرم ہونے کا ثبوت نہیں۔ ان واقعات کا مکمل حل شائع شدہ خلاصے میں واضح نہیں کیا گیا۔
reading_notes.english_notes: The episode has two linked locations: the attack in Constantinople and the detained Ottoman party in Tabriz. Savcu’s arrest is an accusation, not proof of guilt. Tabriz and Tebriz are spelling variants of the same place. When reading an English recap, check whether it is describing the investigation, the envoy party’s predicament or a later resolution; the official synopsis only supports the first two here.
terms: Envoy; the diplomatic role at risk in this episode.
The city where the Ottoman party is trapped.
A council or court; context determines the translation.

overviews.Urdu: An immediate war is avoided, but keeping troops ready in the east makes Mehmed’s return to the Roman campaign expensive. Treasury measures provoke unrest, while the struggle in Karaman places Mustafa in danger. Episode 87 is Season 4 Episode 4 in the Urdu-subtitled guide.
overviews.English: Mehmed resumes his focus on Rome without withdrawing his eastern military readiness. The cost creates pressure in the capital, and a succession struggle in Karaman draws in Mustafa and Gedik Ahmed. Episode 87 links the empire’s finances with the risks faced by its princes.

developments: Two fronts strain the treasury
Maintaining eastern forces while preparing for Rome prompts financial measures and unrest in the capital.
Karaman becomes dangerous
Ishak challenges his brother Suleyman and works with Zeno. Mustafa and Gedik Ahmed are sent into a deadly trap.
Other missions continue
Bayezid receives a Roman assignment as Uzun Hasan investigates Tahrani’s betrayal.
87.context: Episode 86 puts diplomacy at risk. Episode 87 begins after immediate war has been averted, then follows the continuing military costs and a new danger in Karaman.
people: Sent to Karaman, where a trap threatens them.
Brothers at the centre of the Karaman power struggle.
Entrusted with a mission linked to Rome.
87.question: Does the Episode 87 summary reveal what happens to Mustafa?
87.answer: It establishes the trap in Karaman, but does not resolve Mustafa’s fate or document the final scenes. A complete ending recap needs direct episode evidence before it can be published.

watch_tip.Urdu: The Urdu Niazi listing is episode ID 40930, the page used for this guide’s story cross-check. Great Nation labels the same broadcast Episode 4 / Bolum 87.
watch_tip.English: Use the English Niazi listing, episode ID 40931, or select English Subtitles on Great Nation. Do not mistake the Episode 87 Urdu listing for a confirmed English rendition.

reading_notes.urdu_summary: چوتھی قسط میں فوری جنگ ٹل جانے کے باوجود مشرق میں فوج کی تیاری جاری رہتی ہے۔ روم کی مہم اور دوسری سرحد کے اخراجات خزانے پر دباؤ ڈالتے ہیں۔ قرامان میں اقتدار کی کشمکش مصطفیٰ اور گیدک احمد کے لیے خطرہ بن جاتی ہے، جبکہ بایزید کو روم سے متعلق ذمہ داری ملتی ہے۔ خلاصہ مصطفیٰ کے حتمی انجام کی تصدیق نہیں کرتا۔
reading_notes.english_notes: This chapter connects three pressures: military readiness in the east, the treasury cost of preparing for Rome and the Karaman power struggle. Ishak and Suleyman are the brothers involved in that struggle. Mustafa and Gedik Ahmed’s mission is distinct from Bayezid’s Roman assignment. The synopsis establishes a trap in Karaman; it does not resolve Mustafa’s fate, so an ending claim needs evidence beyond the preview.
terms: Treasury; linked to the cost of the two fronts.
The location of the succession struggle.
Prince; distinguish Mustafa’s and Bayezid’s missions.
